sources.entry: udemy-downloader-gui - desktop application for downloading Udemy Courses.

summary.one_liner: Udeler is a cross-platform (Windows, Mac, Linux) desktop GUI app for downloading Udemy courses that you are enrolled in.
summary.what_it_does: Udeler is an Electron-style desktop app (built with npm and Node.js) that lets a logged-in user download Udemy course lecture videos to a local folder. It supports choosing video quality, downloading multiple courses at once, setting a download start and end point, and pausing or resuming downloads. Courses are saved to the user's Download folder by default, preserving the course's content structure. Login is handled through the Udeler Authenticator Chrome extension, which detects a logged-in Udemy session in the browser. The UI is available in English, Italian and Spanish.
use_cases: Download purchased Udemy courses for offline viewing
Batch-download several Udemy courses at once
Save Udemy lecture videos at a chosen quality
Resume an interrupted Udemy course download
Sign in to Udemy from a desktop app via browser extension
how_to_run: Build for your platform with npm run dist, or npm run build-win / build-mac / build-linux / build
For a 32-bit Windows build, append -- --ia32 to the build command
notable: Cross-platform desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux
Login via a companion Chrome extension (Udeler Authenticator)
Pause and resume downloads at any time
Prebuilt downloads listed for Windows x86/x64, Mac x64 and Linux
caveats: Maintenance is temporarily on hold according to the author, who has limited time for fixes and new features
Requires a valid Udemy login for enrolled courses; the README states it only downloads content you have access to
Sharing downloaded course content is prohibited under Udemy's Terms of Use, per the README disclaimer
